data.raw_text:
@kooky__official

1 minute before the voting ended and in the initial “finished” result shown, the vote counts for the other artist still changed — meaning a vote was entered and counted exactly at the closing time, not after the voting period had already ended. If the announcement takes 30 minutes to finalize because you say there was “traffic” in the system, then the first result should not have been posted as if it were already final.

If there is really a traffic delay, then why was a completed vote count shown in the first place? Fans were led to believe the results were final, and because of that, we could no longer act. Had we known that the numbers could still change after the closing time, we also would have dropped additional votes.

The point is: at the last minute and at the actual closing time, the ranking did not change. It only changed after 30 minutes — which you explained as “tallying due to traffic.” But this raises a very important question: why does it take that long if the final counts were already displayed? Showing a supposed “final” result and then changing it later is confusing and unfair to the voters.

Because of this situation, we strongly request for Ziyu to be removed from this voting platform. We do not want to encounter such unfair and misleading circumstances in the future.

data.raw_text:
If you are not attending the annual Navaratri festival at Sri Maha Mariamman Temple, also known as Wat Khaek, it’s best to avoid the Silom area this evening.

Yannawa Metropolitan Police Station has issued a traffic advisory announcing the closure of four main roads in Silom and Sathorn for the temple’s annual procession. The closures run from this afternoon until the early hours of tomorrow:

- Silom Road (in front of Wat Khaek) from Nararom Intersection to Surasak Intersection: closed 16.00 – 04.00 hrs

- Surasak Road: closed along the entire stretch 16.00 – 04.00 hrs

- Narathiwat Ratchanakarin Road (inbound) from Narintorn Intersection to Nararom Intersection: closed 17.00 – 02.00 hrs

- North Sathorn Road from Sathorn Intersection to Narintorn Intersection: closed 19.00 – 04.00 hrs

As no parking is available around the procession area, authorities recommend traveling by BTS Skytrain. The nearest stations to Wat Khaek are:

- BTS Saint Louis Station (approx. 750 meters away)
- BTS Surasak Station and BTS Chong Nonsi Station (approx. 800 meters away)

The BTS operates until midnight, though the last train departs from its originating station slightly earlier.

#Thailand #Bangkok #วัดแขกสีลม
